attr.title: Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack
attr.desc: The original Fancy Pants Adventures (World 1, World 2 and World 3) running in the Ruffle Flash emulator, launched from the Classic Pack hub.
attr.inst: Copy the contents of your Steam Classic Pack install folder into ports/fancypants/gamedata. The first launch patches the game and converts textures, which takes a few minutes.
